settings.heading: How long does the delivery take?
settings.row_content: Our standard shipping usually takes 7 to 14 business days for domestic orders. Please note that delivery times may vary depending on your location and potential shipping delays.

settings.heading: Do you offer international shipping?
settings.row_content: Yes, we offer international shipping. International orders are usually delivered within 7-14 business days, depending on the destination and customs processing time.

settings.heading: How can I track my order?
settings.row_content: You can easily track your order using the tracking number provided in the shipping confirmation email. Simply click on the tracking link in the email, and it will direct you to the courier's website, where you can track the status and location of your package in real time.

settings.heading: Can I cancel my order after I have already paid?
settings.row_content: Once the order has been placed and the payment processed, it is entered into our system for quick processing. Unfortunately, this means we cannot guarantee a cancellation of the order. However, if you need assistance, please contact our customer service as soon as possible, and we will do our best to help you.
